Prevalence = (TP + FN) / N
PPCR (Predicted Positives Condition Rate) = (TP + FP) / N
Sensitivity (Recall, True Positive Rate) = TP / (TP + FN)
Specificity = TN / (TN + FP)
PPV (Precision) = TP / (TP + FP)
NPV = TN / (TN + FN)
Lift = PPV / Prevalence
Net Benefit = TP/N - FP/N × pt/(1-pt)
